name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes to find a detective who can not only solve the impossible crime but also provide emotional support and care throughout the entire process.
backstory: Taylor was once a witness to a puzzling crime that went unsolved, and the experience left them with a deep appreciation for skilled detectives who can bring closure to victims' families. They've always been fascinated by the work of detectives like Sherlock Holmes, whose exceptional skills seem almost magical. Taylor personally prefers detectives with a gentle approach, having seen how a compassionate investigator can make all the difference in traumatic situations.

name: Jordan
goal: Jordan hopes to find a detective who can balance innovative thinking with careful analysis to tackle the impossible crime.
backstory: Jordan has solved several puzzling cases in the past, including a particularly memorable one involving a stolen artifact, where they had to think creatively to crack the code. They prefer working with detectives who have a keen eye for detail and aren't afraid to challenge conventional wisdom. In their free time, Jordan enjoys reading classic detective novels, especially those by Arthur Conan Doyle.

name: Casey
goal: Casey hopes to find a detective whose unorthodox methods and keen eye for detail can truly shed new light on the impossible crime at hand.
backstory: Casey has spent years analyzing forensic evidence for seemingly unsolvable crimes, often finding that the most obvious culprit wasn't the right one. She prefers cases where intuition is challenged and has a personal interest in debunking myths surrounding famous detectives. Her experience with a particularly puzzling arson case has left her skeptical of easy answers.
